notes_for_editor: No build date, staffing schedule or public-access information was found in the sources read; access is omitted rather than guessed. The Register's 100-foot figure is used for height_m, following the convention in other records. The booklet is a Scribd copy of a Division publication, not checked against an original; it is cited only for the Dixie County background, and its text never names Jonesboro. Site described as mostly abandoned by the Division, with the tower still used occasionally. Abandoned has no year, so it is left out of events. The footnote 2 title follows the Scribd page heading.
